类 ProgressSnapshot

java.lang.Object
cn.msscn.progress.ProgressSnapshot
public final class ProgressSnapshot extends Object
Immutable value object returned by the pure API and delivered to callbacks.

  • 构造器详细资料

    • ProgressSnapshot

      public ProgressSnapshot(int index, int count, String name, double value, double total, double percent, double speed, ProgressStatus status, long startedAtMillis, long updatedAtMillis)
      Creates a determinate snapshot (no spinner state).
      参数:
      index - 1-based position in the group
      count - number of bars in the group
      name - the task name
      value - current progress value
      total - target value
      percent - percentage in [0, 100]
      speed - units per second
      status - lifecycle status
      startedAtMillis - start time in epoch millis, or 0 if unknown
      updatedAtMillis - last update time in epoch millis

    • ProgressSnapshot

      public ProgressSnapshot(int index, int count, String name, double value, double total, double percent, double speed, ProgressStatus status, long startedAtMillis, long updatedAtMillis, boolean indeterminate)
      Creates a snapshot, including indeterminate (spinner) state.
      参数:
      index - 1-based position in the group
      count - number of bars in the group
      name - the task name
      value - current progress value
      total - target value
      percent - percentage in [0, 100]
      speed - units per second
      status - lifecycle status
      startedAtMillis - start time in epoch millis, or 0 if unknown
      updatedAtMillis - last update time in epoch millis
      indeterminate - true when the total is unknown
